scope: Adults applying in India for an ordinary passport through the Normal route. Fresh applications, routine reissue, appointment navigation, and document advisor routing.
packaging: Curated paraphrases of verified passages and official source URLs. Original HTML/PDF bytes and completed advisor results are not included.

known_conflicts.observed_disagreement: The application guide states three reschedules outside Tatkaal, whereas the FAQ and PDF state two within a year of the first appointment.
known_conflicts.handling: Do not answer with a numeric limit. Mention the discrepancy if relevant and direct users to the attempts shown in their Passport Seva account.
